title: Complete Guide to LLM Prompt Engineering
title_es: Guía Completa de Prompt Engineering para LLMs
description: Runnable prompt engineering examples from the guide: system prompt contracts, delimiters, few-shot, self-consistency, JSON mode + Pydantic validation, RAG grounding, function calling loop, and an offline-capable evaluation harness with a golden dataset.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de prompt engineering de la guía: contratos de system prompt, delimitadores, few-shot, self-consistency, modo JSON + validación con Pydantic, grounding con RAG, bucle de function calling y un harness de evaluación con dataset dorado.
